title: Outlook: Keep folders expanded when you restart Outlook
description: Outlook will remember which folders and shared mailboxes you have expanded or collapsed when you restart the app. You can pick up where you left off without opening the same folder branches again. This makes returning to your usual folders easier. #newoutlookforwindows
